name: Kiro codec
summary: Converts a Spekkr spec folder to a Kiro feature folder and back, byte for byte. One Python script and an agent skill.

files.about: Requirements R1-R14 with acceptance checks: feature folder, byte-for-byte sidecar, safety block, requirements.md, steering, the hand-written fixed point, the filled-in manifest, collisions, no reformatting, edge bytes, all-or-nothing writes, the warning, the agent skill, and the checker.
Command line, mapping, sidecar, safety block bytes, steering rules, Kiro citations, filled-in manifest, every error message, the checker, and unverified Kiro behavior.
Build order. Each step has a check. This version ships no reference implementation.

changelog.note: to-spekkr now refuses a design.md that starts with the safety marker but is not the full safety block, so the round trip stays exact. A tested implementation is at github.com/dwrtz/kiro-codec.
First version. Spec only. Kiro docs checked 20 November 2026. No codec in this folder yet.
